name: kda-rounding-v1
scope: MXFP8 weight-only roundtrip using identical BF16 GEMMs; no native MXFP8 speed/memory qualification

datasets.join_policy: two newlines between every parquet row, including empty rows

tasks.name: json_types
tasks.prompt: Return only JSON with keys enabled=false, retries=0, note=null, tags=["red","blue"].

tasks.name: constraints
tasks.prompt: Return exactly three lines: ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, in that order. No numbering.

tasks.name: unicode_copy
tasks.prompt: Copy exactly the following text, with no quotes or explanation: Київ — München — 42

tasks.name: slugify
tasks.prompt: Write only Python code defining slugify(text: str) -> str. Normalize with unicodedata NFKD, remove non-ASCII characters, lowercase, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with a hyphen, strip leading/trailing hyphens. Return an empty string for empty input. No markdown or explanation.

tasks.name: merge_intervals
tasks.prompt: Write only Python code defining merge_intervals(intervals). Input is a list of [start,end] integer lists. Return a list of two-element lists, sorted by start, representing merged closed intervals; touching endpoints merge. Do not mutate the input. Handle empty input. No markdown or explanation.

tasks.name: multiply
tasks.prompt: What is 17 times 23? Reply only with the integer answer.

tasks.name: inventory
tasks.prompt: A box has 12 blue balls and 8 red balls. You remove 5 blue balls. How many balls remain? Reply only with the integer answer.

limitations: Weight-only diagnostic; BF16 execution does not qualify native MXFP8 GEMMs or activation quantization.
C1 only; not a concurrent-serving qualification.
32 sampled WikiText windows are not standard full-corpus perplexity.
Eight practical tasks are a smoke screen, not a full task benchmark.
Capture synchronizes logits to CPU; latency cannot be used for serving-speed claims.
First baseline greedy tokens freeze the actual-KV continuation; later legs retain raw logits before forcing it.
The unchanged 1e-5 KL threshold is reported without assuming it will fail or pass.
